title: Editor E5 slice: the canvas edits a real Space page draft
detail:
Split from PROG-E5 on 2026-11-16. The staff, EDITOR_CANVAS-gated /pages/canvas edited one local demo Banner. This slice wires it to a real node document. Dark.

Premise re-tested (ADR-1082): node documents already have a draft store, the Space page's `spaces.preferences.profileLayoutDraft` beside the published `profileLayout`, the pair the Space page builder autosaves into and publishes from. The marketing `pages` rows and `page_versions` hold the older page-editor document, not nodes, and `loom_functions` (migration 048000) holds function declarations, so neither can hold a canvas draft. No migration.

What now works: `/pages/canvas?space=<id or address>` reads that Space page (draft, else published) through resolveSpaceManageAccess, the Space page builder's own rule (lib/builder/canvas-document-load.ts). The layer list lists the page's placed nodes and its Edit button picks one; the inspector shows that node with fields from its own block contract (lib/builder/canvas-inspector.ts over ADOPTED_BLOCKS, `space-profile` surface). An edit (desktop content or a sparse tablet or phone override) is saved by one server action (app/(main)/pages/canvas/document-actions.ts) to the DRAFT only. The save carries the base the tab loaded: a revision counter kept at `preferences.profileLayoutDraftRevision` and a fingerprint of the document. The fingerprint is checked against a fresh read; the counter is compared inside the single UPDATE that writes (writeSpacePreferencesAtRevision in lib/spaces/store.ts: update where id and stored counter match), so a stale tab gets a conflict and writes nothing. Saving needs a manager of the Space and render_path_space_profile on; a staff preview and a Space still on the older layout are read only, and say so. Nothing publishes. The demo Banner stays when no Space is named or the Space has no page. A device override can now hold an empty string, a default toggle or a default choice (explicitResets in lib/entity-blocks/node-ops.ts), with no document shape change.

VERIFIED: pure model tests, the action and loader tests with the data layer mocked, the guarded-update statement test, the client save hook under jsdom, SSR markup on a Callout and a Text block, and a route test that the switch off is a 404 before anything is read. NOT VERIFIED: no browser render and no real database call were made, so the PostgREST filter on `preferences->>profileLayoutDraftRevision` has not run against Postgres.

Known limits, stated plainly: the guarded write replaces the whole preferences blob (there is no SQL function for this key), so a different preferences key saved in the few milliseconds between the action's read and its write is reverted, the same exposure the Space page builder's own draft save has today; the Space page builder does not move the counter, so a builder save landing inside that same window is not caught by the update (the fingerprint catches it outside the window). Closing both needs a small SQL function, which is a migration and an owner decision. Edits do not travel over the shared CRDT channel; layer order on the canvas is not saved; rich text shows as its stored markup in the inspector; Vera's coach stays on the demo block only.

verify.note: Fails on main: no canvas document model, no draft read, no guarded draft write. Passes once the canvas reads a real Space page document behind the Space page builder's access rule, derives the inspector from the selected node's block contract, and saves to the draft through one action whose update compares the revision, with the tests present.
